interaction_rules: IR-001: Progressive form validation after first submit, blinds/stack validated on blur
IR-002: PioSOLVER path auto-detection on blur, test button enabled only when path valid
IR-003: CFR file loading with progress bar and retry on failure
IR-004: Action buttons disabled during non-player turns with BOT thinking animation
IR-005: Raise uses slider with preset anchors plus direct input with range validation
IR-006: Fold confirmation only when player can check but chooses fold
IR-007: Keyboard shortcuts F/C/R/A for actions with visual hints on buttons
IR-008: Deal and chip animations 300-500ms, toggle in settings
IR-009: Analysis mode toggle persists across hands
IR-010: GTO panel defaults collapsed showing recommended action and EV only
IR-011: EV diff color coding: ≤0.5bb green, 0.5-2bb yellow, >2bb red
IR-012: Post-hand summary card auto-shows, dismissible after 3s, non-blocking
IR-013: Skeleton screen during table initialization
IR-014: Empty state with CTA for hand history when no hands played
IR-015: Insufficient data notice when < 20 hands in stats
IR-016: UPI features grayed with tooltip when PioSOLVER not configured
IR-017: Confirm dialog on leaving active game: save/discard/cancel
IR-018: Session delete requires confirmation with session summary
IR-019: Main nav always visible, collapses to mini mode on table page
IR-020: UPI timeout >10s triggers fallback to built-in strategy with toast notification
IR-021: SQLite error shows toast with auto-retry, persistent failure shows error dialog
IR-022: Bet sizing classification note displayed as footnote in GTO comparison panel
